description: Na₂MnH₄(SeO₅)₂ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. Na is bonded to seven O atoms to form distorted NaO₇ pentagonal bipyramids that share corners with two equivalent NaO₇ pentagonal bipyramids, corners with four equivalent SeO₄ tetrahedra, edges with two equivalent MnO₆ octahedra,  an edgeedge with one NaO₇ pentagonal bipyramid, and  an edgeedge with one SeO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.41-2.77 Å. Mn is bonded to six O atoms to form MnO₆ octahedra that share corners with four equivalent SeO₄ tetrahedra and edges with four equivalent NaO₇ pentagonal bipyramids. There are a spread of Mn-O bond distances ranging from 2.17-2.25 Å. There are two inequivalent H sites. In the first H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to two O atoms. There is one shorter (0.99 Å) and one longer (1.75 Å) H-O bond length. In the second H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to two O atoms. There is one shorter (1.00 Å) and one longer (1.77 Å) H-O bond length. Se is bonded to four O atoms to form SeO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent MnO₆ octahedra, corners with four equivalent NaO₇ pentagonal bipyramids, and  an edgeedge with one NaO₇ pentagonal bipyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 44-52°. There are a spread of Se-O bond distances ranging from 1.66-1.69 Å. There are five inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted water-like geometry to one Na, one Mn, and two H atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one H, and one Se atom. In the third O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na, one Mn, and one Se atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₂MnSe tetrahedra. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to one Na, one Mn, and one Se atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one H, and one Se atom.
